# IStakingRewardsManagerBaseErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rewards-contracts/src/interfaces/IStakingRewardsManagerBaseErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IStakingRewardsManagerBaseErrors

Interface defining custom errors for the Staking Rewards Manager


## Errors
### CannotStakeZero
Thrown when attempting to stake zero tokens


```solidity
error CannotStakeZero();
```

### CannotWithdrawZero
Thrown when attempting to withdraw zero tokens


```solidity
error CannotWithdrawZero();
```

### ProvidedRewardTooHigh
Thrown when the provided reward amount is too high


```solidity
error ProvidedRewardTooHigh();
```

### RewardPeriodNotComplete
Thrown when trying to set rewards before the current period is complete


```solidity
error RewardPeriodNotComplete();
```

### NoRewardTokens
Thrown when there are no reward tokens set


```solidity
error NoRewardTokens();
```

### RewardTokenAlreadyExists
Thrown when trying to add a reward token that already exists


```solidity
error RewardTokenAlreadyExists();
```

### InvalidRewardsDuration
Thrown when setting an invalid rewards duration


```solidity
error InvalidRewardsDuration();
```

### RewardTokenNotInitialized
Thrown when trying to interact with a reward token that hasn't been initialized


```solidity
error RewardTokenNotInitialized();
```

### InvalidRewardAmount
Thrown when the reward amount is invalid for the given duration


```solidity
error InvalidRewardAmount(address rewardToken, uint256 rewardsDuration);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`rewardToken`|`address`|The address of the reward token|
|`rewardsDuration`|`uint256`|The duration for which the reward is invalid|

### StakingTokenNotInitialized
Thrown when trying to interact with the staking token before it's initialized


```solidity
error StakingTokenNotInitialized();
```

### RewardTokenDoesNotExist
Thrown when trying to remove a reward token that doesn't exist


```solidity
error RewardTokenDoesNotExist();
```

### CannotChangeRewardsDuration
Thrown when trying to change the rewards duration of a reward token


```solidity
error CannotChangeRewardsDuration();
```

### RewardTokenStillHasBalance
Thrown when a reward token still has a balance


```solidity
error RewardTokenStillHasBalance(uint256 balance);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`balance`|`uint256`|The remaining balance of the reward token|

### IndexOutOfBounds
Thrown when the index is out of bounds


```solidity
error IndexOutOfBounds();
```

### RewardsDurationCannotBeZero
Thrown when the rewards duration is zero


```solidity
error RewardsDurationCannotBeZero();
```

### CannotUnstakeZero
Thrown when attempting to unstake zero tokens


```solidity
error CannotUnstakeZero();
```

### RewardsDurationTooLong
Thrown when the rewards duration is too long


```solidity
error RewardsDurationTooLong();
```

### CannotStakeToZeroAddress
Thrown when the receiver is the zero address


```solidity
error CannotStakeToZeroAddress();
```
